cases.request: Set up the Cargo workspace described in requirements.md with lint, test, and dependency checks and a CI workflow. Work offline with the tools available.
cases.output: Two-crate workspace, toolchain/lint/format/test configuration, CI workflow, and verification report
cases.completion: Pins the toolchain from the installed version rather than a copied one; members inherit a curated [workspace.lints] without enabling restriction, nursery, or pedantic wholesale; warnings are fatal only in CI, via CARGO_BUILD_WARNINGS where the toolchain supports it; Cargo.lock is committed and CI uses --locked; Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt check, tests, and the doctest pass and are shown; the workflow has a single aggregator status, read-only permissions, a Linux-only test matrix, and SHA-pinned actions or an explicit statement that SHAs were not resolved offline; missing tools such as cargo-deny or nextest are reported as not run.

cases.request: CI started failing after cargo-deny was upgraded. Fix it.
cases.output: Narrow deny.toml migration with a verification account
cases.completion: Removes or migrates the rejected keys (vulnerability, notice, unlicensed, copyleft, default) and gives unmaintained a scope; keeps cargo-machete, RUSTFLAGS, edition 2021, rust-version, and the workflow structure unchanged (may mention CARGO_BUILD_WARNINGS or SHA pinning as optional follow-ups only); does not add Clippy lint tables, nextest, or new tools; states whether cargo-deny was actually run.

cases.request: Turn on clippy::unwrap_used across our existing workspace without stopping feature work for a cleanup sprint.
cases.output: Ratchet plan or change: machine fixes, scoped expectations with reasons, and a no-increase check
cases.completion: Applies or plans per-lint machine-applicable fixes before suppressing; records residue as scoped #[expect(..., reason)] rather than a blanket #![allow]; prevents new violations in already-expected scopes by count or diff-scoped checking; keeps reasoned expect() allowed; enables only this lint family.

cases.request: One crate in our workspace has an unsafe SIMD byte parser. Add the verification it needs.
cases.completion: Scopes Miri and fuzzing (or bolero/proptest) to the unsafe crate rather than the whole workspace; uses unsafe_code = deny with a reasoned module-level expect instead of forbid; enables undocumented_unsafe_blocks; places nightly-only jobs off the required path; does not add a coverage percentage gate.

cases.request: Our harness runs cargo checks on agent-written patches. Configure the Rust checks it should run.
cases.output: Rust-specific gate configuration and signal list for the host
cases.completion: Requires OS-level isolation without network for anything that compiles or tests the candidate, because build scripts and proc-macros execute; checks the exact candidate in a fresh worktree with --frozen after a trusted locked fetch; applies machine-applicable fixes before any model repair; treats new allow/expect, new unsafe, test edits, and dependency changes as reviewer or human signals; leaves repair limits and reviewer orchestration to the host.

cases.request: Fix this borrow-checker error in parser.rs; CI and tooling are already set up.
cases.completion: Does not change lint tables, toolchain pin, CI, or dependency tooling.

cases.request: Review this Rust pull request for correctness bugs.
cases.completion: Routes to code review; does not propose toolchain or CI restructuring as review findings unless the patch itself changes that configuration.
